vendors.name: OrderBahamas
vendors.reason: diner marketplace: restaurants join as sellers, customers pay an 11% service charge ("Restaurants are never billed fees."); pay-ahead pickup ("Pay ahead & skip the line") but a marketplace -> never counted. Says it works with restaurants' existing Square systems

notes: Nothing eligible with a BSD price; no Bahamian ordering tool a business can buy was found. OrderBahamas is a diner marketplace (customer pays 11%). Bahamagrub, JustFoodz are marketplaces / directories (never counted). Several Nassau takeaways run their own "Order online" pages with pickup ("Takeaway food - Nassau - Order online", manually confirmed orders) — the wording looks like GloriaFood restaurant sites (agent 1/5 region; not read, the vendor is not named on those pages in the snippets). Square: its own availability list (wave 1, read today) does not include the Bahamas, although OrderBahamas mentions restaurants using Square there; Toast / Clover / Owner.com show no Bahamas presence. Pedix / OlaClick / Fudo do not cover the English-speaking Caribbean. One search only: the snippets showed nothing else plausible.
